name: Tiger Winter Cheer
tagline: Courtside all winter — Tiger Cheer's own Varsity sideline squad.

headCoach.name: Lisa McDonald
headCoach.bio: Coach Lisa McDonald brings nearly 25 years of cheer coaching experience to Tiger Cheer, with deep roots in high school sideline & competitive and all-star cheer. Now in her 7th fall season as head coach at SLOHS, she has grown the program from a single varsity team to five thriving teams. Last year she launched the Traditional Competitive Cheer (TCC) team, which qualified for State in their very first season. Her coaching philosophy is rooted in developing the whole athlete — building the skills & confidence that carry them to success on the mat, on the sideline, & beyond.
